name: Mesenchyme-driven epithelial organogenesis, chiefly lung and trachea
rationale: Members concern epithelial-mesenchymal signalling and mesenchymal proliferation in branching/budding organs (lung, trachea, salivary gland, palate, limb bud), and the lung, airway and pneumocyte members distinguish it from the prostate and pancreas/kidney confusables.

name: Monocyte endothelial adhesion, extravasation and inflammatory activation
rationale: Members regulate monocyte/macrophage activation, chemotaxis, adhesion to vascular endothelium and extravasation in inflammation, and the adhesion-molecule and extravasation control separates it from monocyte surface-signature, CCR2/CX3CR1 and synoviocyte confusables.

name: Neurotrophin signaling via TRKB receptor
rationale: All members describe BDNF/NT-3/NT-4 activation of NTRK2 (TRKB) and its PI3K, RAS, PLCG1, FRS2 and RAC1 effectors, distinguishing it from TRKA and TRKC signalling and NMDAR-driven synaptic plasticity confusables.

name: Implantation-site trophoblast giant cells and decidualization
rationale: Members cover endoreduplicating trophoblast giant cell differentiation and decidualization in early pregnancy, unlike the labyrinth trophoblast, germ cell, ovarian and zygotic confusables.

name: Phosphoryl transfer among nucleotides and inositol pyrophosphates
rationale: Members interconvert nucleoside mono/di/triphosphates and synthesize or hydrolyse inositol and adenosine pyrophosphates, which separates it from creatine/mitochondrial ADP transport, deoxynucleotide synthesis and phosphoinositide confusables.

name: RUNX1-regulated myeloid progenitor and megakaryocyte differentiation
rationale: Members describe RUNX1-driven transcriptional control of myeloid progenitor fate, megakaryocyte/platelet development and restraint of other myeloid lineages, lacking the erythroid and stem-cell maintenance members of its confusables.

name: CFTR trafficking and epithelial anion and water transport
rationale: Members concern CFTR biosynthetic trafficking to the plasma membrane and the anion and transepithelial water transport it mediates, unlike apical raft-localization and TRP/secretion confusables.

name: Death receptor caspase-8 signaling to apoptosis and necroptosis
rationale: Members cover Fas/TRAIL/TLR3-TRIF death signalling through caspase-8, c-FLIP and BID plus RIPK-dependent necroptosis, distinguishing it from mitochondrial intrinsic apoptosis, execution-phase DNA fragmentation and tissue-specific apoptosis confusables.

name: G2 DNA damage checkpoint and p53 protein stability control
rationale: Members describe radiation-induced G2 checkpoint signalling with post-translational control of p53 by phosphorylation and degradation, whereas confusables add p53 transcriptional target programmes, COP1 and CDC25A degradation.

name: Myeloid progenitor commitment and restraint of monocyte-granulocyte differentiation
rationale: Members cover myeloid progenitor proliferation and granulopoiesis transcription with negative regulation of monocyte, macrophage and granulocyte differentiation, unlike confusables that promote monocyte/DC differentiation or centre on RUNX1-megakaryocyte biology.

name: Fc gamma receptor phagocytosis and phagocytic cup actin
rationale: All three members describe FcgR-triggered phagocytosis and actin remodelling of the phagocytic cup, distinct from Fc inhibitory signalling and lamellipodial actin confusables.

name: Endocardial cushion transformation and heart valve morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover endocardial differentiation, cushion EMT and fusion, and formation of all four cardiac valves, unlike myocardial, septal and trabecular heart development confusables.

name: Gonadotropin-driven ovarian follicle, luteal and testis development
rationale: Members concern GnRH/LH/FSH glycoprotein hormone signalling and the follicle growth, ovulation, luteinization, Leydig and Sertoli development they control, distinguishing it from activin/AMH and oocyte maturation confusables.

name: Biogenic amine catabolism and organic cation transport
rationale: Members describe MAO/COMT/FMO degradation of dopamine, serotonin and other amines plus organic cation transport and choline/carnitine amine metabolism, whereas confusables centre on catecholamine and serotonin biosynthesis.

qualifier: centrosome maturation and duplication, spindle positioning
name: Centrosome maturation, duplication and mitotic spindle positioning
rationale: Members concern centriole duplication, mitotic centrosome protein recruitment via PLK1/AURKA and spindle assembly and orientation, lacking the cytokinesis, kinetochore and cilium members of confusables.

name: Adipocyte glucose uptake and adiponectin secretion
rationale: The three members concern promotion of cellular glucose import and adiponectin secretion, without the insulin receptor, AKT2 and GLUT4 translocation members of confusables.

name: Renal urate transport and metabolism
rationale: All members concern urate transport and metabolism including SLC2A9/SLC22A12 renal hypouricemia, unlike hexose, cystine and drug-anion transporter confusables.

name: Embryonic craniofacial and skull morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover head, face, nose and neuro-/viscerocranium morphogenesis, lacking the palate, pharyngeal gland, limb and inner ear members of confusables.

name: Pre-mRNA 3'-end cleavage, polyadenylation and histone mRNA processing
rationale: Members describe Pol II termination-coupled 3'-end cleavage and polyadenylation and SLBP-related histone pre-mRNA processing, unlike snRNA/splicing, mRNA decay and mRNA export confusables.

name: Trans-Golgi network vesicle trafficking to endosomes and lysosomes
rationale: Members cover Golgi-associated and lysosomal vesicle biogenesis and anterograde Golgi-to-endosome/lysosome transport, whereas confusables emphasize retrograde endosome-to-Golgi and COPI intra-Golgi traffic.

name: Glucagon, somatostatin and fatty-acid receptor cAMP signaling
rationale: Members are G protein-coupled receptors for glucagon-family peptides, somatostatin, free fatty acids and hydroxycarboxylic acids that regulate adenylate cyclase, unlike calcitonin/amylin and incretin-insulin secretion confusables.

name: Xenobiotic and phytochemical biotransformation with FMO oxidation
rationale: Members cover phase I/II metabolism of xenobiotics, steroids and plant-derived compounds by CYPs, FMOs, sulfonation and acetylation, with FMO and natural-product catabolism absent from methylation, paracetamol and aflatoxin confusables.

name: T cell activation and CD8 and gamma-delta differentiation
rationale: Members describe T cell signalling, costimulation and differentiation including CD8 alpha-beta and gamma-delta lineages, unlike thymocyte/B cell, IL-2/IL-7 cytokine and proximal TCR confusables.

name: Viral protein maturation and virion assembly, mainly coronavirus
rationale: Members describe post-translational maturation of SARS-CoV, dengue and RSV proteins and assembly at the budding site, whereas confusables centre on virus attachment and entry.

name: Commissural axon guidance with ephrin and L1 signaling
rationale: Members cover netrin-DCC attraction, SLIT-ROBO commissural pathfinding, ephrin repulsion and L1-mediated fasciculation, distinguishing it from netrin/semaphorin repulsion and ROBO-GTPase confusables.
